title: Salts of Chasm Creeper
summary: Alchemy extract used to make Elixir of the Colossus.

fields.Recipe: Combine these salts with any Suspension to make Elixir of the Colossus.
fields.Result: Enlarges you, gives Advantage on Strength checks and saves, and adds 1d4 weapon damage until Long Rest.
fields.Base value: 25 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
